QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_48

question.text: Which of the following is a FUND-LEVEL risk (governance category) rather than an investor-level risk?

answer.text: Cash management risk of an institutional LP
Risk associated with fund structure and governance (fiduciary duty) — reliance on trustee, manager, service providers
Risk of adverse selection of manager by the investor
Illiquidity uncertainty as seen by a specific LP

explanation.text: The Logic: Governance / fund-level risks include reliance on trustee, manager, IM committees, service providers — these are FUND-LEVEL structural risks. A, C, D are INVESTOR-LEVEL risks as classified in Chapter 7. The Trap: A, C, D are investor-level per the chapter's explicit taxonomy. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-B Cat III Distributor presents these risks to investors; XIX-E tests from manager governance angle.
